prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a revised whole-body running key pose for this exact adult silver-haired swordsman, facing screen right. Transparent background. Requested native canvas 2560x1440.
Image 1 is the approved character and NORMAL FORWARD sword grip anatomy reference. Follow its fingers, thumb, guard and handle relationship, costume and adult proportions. Image 2 is reference for the neutral standing scale and costume ONLY; its trailing-arm sword grip was rejected and must NOT be copied.
Composition: two complete figures at the SAME anatomical scale, neutral standing profile on the left third, one full running figure on the right two thirds. Leave generous clear margins around hair, boots and blade, no cropping. Neutral height about 85% canvas height. Maintain compact adult head, approximately 7 heads tall. Detailed clean painted anime game art with consistent silver hair, black long coat red lining, black trousers, armored boots, red fingerless hand wraps.
Running figure: redraw as ONE coordinated human from head through shoulders, spine, pelvis to both complete legs. Run toward right, torso leaning forward about 25 degrees, eyes ahead, one leg supporting under center of mass and opposite leg folding behind. Coat trails to left. Natural athletic posture.
Critical correction: the CAMERA-NEAR RIGHT upper arm runs down and slightly back alongside the ribs, elbow clearly bent about 90 degrees; forearm returns forward, right fist rests near the front of the hip at waist height. Wrist straight and continuous with forearm. Hold the katana in a conventional forward grip, NOT reverse grip. Pinky toward pommel (rear/left), index and thumb close to guard (front/right), all four fingers convincingly wrap around the narrow handle. Blade emerges from guard on thumb/index side and extends forward/right at a slight downward angle, outside the legs, clearly above ground. Katana cutting edge faces down. Show the hilt, fingers and guard clearly so the grip reads instantly. Relaxed shoulder, controlled bent elbow; no stiff straight trailing arm, no twisted wrist, no handle passing through knuckles. Free far arm counter-swings naturally without touching weapon.
This is a static full-character anatomy proposal, no animation sheet, no detached body parts, no labels, no effects, no motion blur, no duplicate swords or scabbards. Draw the entire pose together; do not paste legs or arms onto a fixed torso.
